items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: cn() (clsx + tailwind-merge) and the WithElementRef / WithoutChild… type helpers. Every item depends on it.

items.name: agent-tree
items.title: Agent tree
items.description: Coding agents as a process tree, with the rules Linux uses: every agent has a pid, a parent and exactly one state (working R, waiting or needs-you S, paused T, done or failed with an exit code); you are process 1 at the top. Selecting an agent shows its reach: what it steers (everything below it, in the one colour) and whom it reports to. Sockets between siblings, opened by a shared ancestor, and two agents in one file show on the rows. Keyboard: arrows move, Enter selects. An `actions` snippet renders the app's own Pause, Stop, Message inside the selected row.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number input
items.description: A number you step with two chevrons or type; the digits roll to the new value, as an odometer does, so you see what changed and which way. Arrow keys step (Shift: ten steps; Home and End: the bounds), a chevron held keeps stepping, and the field never holds an invalid value: typed text is taken as soon as it reads as a number and clamped when you leave. Formats through Intl.NumberFormat (locale, currency, decimals). AnimatedNumber, the rolling digits, is exported on its own for a counter that only shows.

items.name: time-wheel
items.title: Time wheel
items.description: A time you set by turning a wheel, in two styles: flat, as on iOS (the neighbours shrink and fade), or a drum (the rows sit on a cylinder). Hours and minutes in 24 or 12 hours with an am/pm column, one highlight bar across the columns. Drag, mouse wheel, click a row, or ArrowUp/ArrowDown on a focused column (instant). Wheel is one column on its own, for any list.
